scripts.test:host-parity: cargo build -p alpha2-host -p alpha2-native && node scripts/test-host-cli-parity.mjs
scripts.test:node-e2e: cargo build -p alpha2-host && npm run build --workspace @alpha2-sh/node && node --test packages/alpha2-node/test/e2e/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:node-e2e:release: cargo build --release -p alpha2-host && npm run build --workspace @alpha2-sh/node && ALPHA2_HOST_BINARY=target/release/alpha2-host node --test packages/alpha2-node/test/e2e/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:vulkan-validation: cargo build --release -p alpha2-host && cargo build --release -p alpha2-native --features hwdecode && node scripts/test-vulkan-validation.mjs
scripts.generate:schema: cargo run --quiet -p alpha2-model --features schema --example emit-schema -- schema && node scripts/generate-project-types.mjs
scripts.test:js: npm run build:js --workspace alpha2 && npm run build --workspace @alpha2-sh/node && npm run build --workspace @alpha2-sh/react && node --test packages/alpha2/test/*.test.mjs packages/alpha2-node/test/*.test.mjs packages/alpha2-react/test/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/lib/*.test.mjs && npm run test:editor
